description: Test suite for concept vocabulary functions related to concept tag classification, derivation, and coverage summarization.

methods.name: classifyConceptTagScript
methods.description: Classifies a concept tag string into script family: 'latin', 'cjk', or 'mixed'.

methods.name: deriveConceptTags

methods.name: summarizeConceptTagScriptCoverage
methods.description: Summarizes the coverage of concept tags across Latin, CJK, and mixed scripts.
